raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- Replace `dsv41_dspark_needs_rebootstrap` with `dsv4_needs_rebootstrap`: every DeepSeek-V4 decode server now recovers a retracted request by recomputing its prefix on the prefill. Before, only V4.1 with DSpark did; DeepSeek-V4 and V4.1 without DSpark resolved to the `cpu_tensor` backup, which `DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool` does not implement, so the decode scheduler crashed with `NotImplementedError` on its first retraction.
- `backup_kv_cache` checks `none` first, so an explicit `--disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup none` still aborts the request. A DeepSeek-V4 request with multimodal inputs is aborted, since the recompute payload carries token ids only.
- A retraction that aborts without a host-pool backup reports 503 "Retry later" instead of "Retraction host KV pool exhausted".
- Rebootstrap skips the prefill recompute for a fake transfer, whose receiver completes on its own; before, both the fake transfer backend and a request with the fake bootstrap host raised `AttributeError` on the decode scheduler.
- `test_disaggregation_dsv4.py` forces retraction on the decode worker and checks after GSM8K that the worker stays up and retracted at least once.

Behavior change: a DeepSeek-V4 PD decode server recomputes retracted requests instead of crashing. With `none`, and for requests with images, it aborts with 503 instead; this also applies to V4.1 with DSpark, which before recomputed in both cases (dropping the images).

Fixes #33385

+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode import DecodePreallocQueue, DecodeRequest
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import FAKE_BOOTSTRAP_HOST
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import ReqKvInfo
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.common import backup_kv_cache
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.deepseek_v4_memory_pool import DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _allocator(pool_cls):
+    # Buffers are never touched: the pool class alone decides the recovery path.
+    pool = pool_cls.__new__(pool_cls)
+    pool.device = "cpu"
+    return SimpleNamespace(get_kvcache=lambda: pool)
+
+
+def _req(multimodal_inputs=None):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        kv=ReqKvInfo(),
+        seqlen=8,
+        multimodal_inputs=multimodal_inputs,
+        offload_kv_cache=MagicMock(),
+    )
+
+
+class TestDSV4RetractRebootstrap(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_dsv4_backup_decision(self):
+        cases = [
+            # The default backend; the pool has no host copy, so the prefill recomputes.
+            ("default backend", _req(), "cpu_tensor", True),
+            # An explicit none still means abort, not recompute.
+            ("none backend", _req(), "none", False),
+            # The recompute payload carries token ids only.
+            ("image request", _req(multimodal_inputs=object()), "cpu_tensor", False),
+        ]
+        for name, req, backend, saved in cases:
+            with self.subTest(case=name):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    backup_kv_cache(
+                        req, None, None, _allocator(DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool), backend
+                    ),
+                    saved,
+                )
+                req.offload_kv_cache.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_fake_transfer_skips_prefill_recompute(self):
+        # Neither the fake manager nor a fake receiver can dispatch a recompute.
+        queue = DecodePreallocQueue.__new__(DecodePreallocQueue)
+        queue.kv_manager = MagicMock()
+        req = MagicMock(bootstrap_host=FAKE_BOOTSTRAP_HOST)
+        queue._submit_prefill_recompute(DecodeRequest(req=req, kv_receiver=MagicMock()))
+        queue.kv_manager.submit_prefill_recompute.assert_not_called()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
